script: if (window.frappe && root_element) { var wsName = 'IT & Infrastructure'; if (frappe.get_route) { var route = frappe.get_route(); if (route && route[0] === 'workspaces' && route[1]) { wsName = decodeURIComponent(route[1]); var data = r.message; var root = root_element; var ws = data.workspace || {}; var elTitle = root.querySelector('#bwh-title'); if (elTitle && ws.title) elTitle.textContent = ws.title; var elDesc = root.querySelector('#bwh-description'); if (elDesc && ws.description) elDesc.textContent = ws.description; var elPole = root.querySelector('#bwh-pole-tag'); if (elPole) { if (ws.pole) { elPole.textContent = ws.pole; elPole.style.display = 'inline-block'; } else { elPole.style.display = 'none'; } } var elBc = root.querySelector('#bwh-breadcrumb-target'); if (elBc && ws.name) elBc.textContent = ws.name; var elStatus = root.querySelector('#bwh-status-text'); var elCurAvatar = root.querySelector('#bwh-cur-avatar-wrap'); if (elCurAvatar) { elCurAvatar.innerHTML = ''; if (cur.user_image) { var img = document.createElement('img'); img.className = 'bwh-avatar-img'; img.src = cur.user_image; img.alt = cur.full_name || cur.name; elCurAvatar.appendChild(img); } else { var initSpan = document.createElement('span'); initSpan.className = 'bwh-avatar-initials'; initSpan.textContent = cur.initials || 'BG'; elCurAvatar.appendChild(initSpan); } } var members = data.members || []; var total = data.total_members || members.length; var stack = root.querySelector('#bwh-avatar-stack'); if (stack) { stack.innerHTML = ''; members.slice(0, 4).forEach(function(m) { var item = document.createElement('div'); item.className = 'bwh-member-item'; item.title = (m.full_name || m.name) + (m.email ? ' (' + m.email + ')' : ''); if (m.user_image) { var mImg = document.createElement('img'); mImg.className = 'bwh-avatar-img'; mImg.src = m.user_image; mImg.alt = m.full_name || m.name; item.appendChild(mImg); } else { var mInit = document.createElement('span'); mInit.className = 'bwh-avatar-initials member'; mInit.textContent = m.initials || 'U'; item.appendChild(mInit); } stack.appendChild(item); }); if (total > 4) { var moreBadge = document.createElement('div'); moreBadge.className = 'bwh-avatar-more'; moreBadge.textContent = '+' + (total - 4); moreBadge.title = '+' + (total - 4) + ' autres membres habilités'; stack.appendChild(moreBadge); } } } }); }
